name: Kuma
source:
Teddie's human form. After defeating his Shadow and grasping his identity, he somehow developed an ego and know hosts a human's body inside his bear suit, instead of just being empty like before. Just like the "original" Teddie, he is a flirtatious, bubbly and knows how to lighten up the mood. After settling down in the real world, he starts living with Yosuke's family and helps out at Junes.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Teddie]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]
